q: The holy book of Islam is...
exp: The Quran is the holy book of Islam.
Prophet Muhammad (SAW) is the founder of Islam.

q: How many pillars of Islam are there?
exp: There are 5 pillars of Islam: Shahada, Salat, Zakat, Sawm, and Hajj.

q: The city of Mecca is located in which country?
exp: Mecca is located in Saudi Arabia.

q: The month of fasting in Islam is called...
exp: Ramadan is the month of fasting in Islam.
Zakat is the giving of charity (obligatory alms) in Islam.
